title: cordylanthus littoralis
intro: Cordylanthus littoralis, commonly known as Beach Plume or Seaside Plume, is a rare and endangered plant species found in the coastal regions of California, USA. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Cordylanthus littoralis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, supporting cardiovascular health and immune system function. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
